title: Workbench manifest fragment
description: The build-emitted `manifest.json` a plugin's OWNING repo writes into its dist/ (HK-11). Machine form of `ManifestFragment` in packages/workbench/src/contract.ts — the two are kept field-identical by the owner guard. Unknown extra keys are tolerated (additive minors).

id.description: Plugin id; also the route segment under /p/<id>/.

entry.description: ESM entry, relative to the fragment. Default export: WorkbenchPlugin.

styles.description: Stylesheets the shell injects/removes, relative to the fragment.

peers.description: Strict-major match against the shell singletons (react, react-dom, react-router-dom, locveil-ui-kit); a mismatch is refuse-and-surface. Non-singleton peers are the plugin's own business.

backendCompat.description: Optional per-plugin backend compatibility statement (informational in v1).
